tfimpact: 1 change destroys data, 1 minor, 1 routine
Plan: 2 to add, 0 to change, 2 to destroy (1 move, 2 unchanged). Terraform/OpenTofu 1.15.5 · 6 resources.

CRITICAL (1)
  * aws_s3_bucket.logs is renamed to aws_s3_bucket.audit_logs without a moved block, so it will be destroyed and recreated [PLAN-RENAME-001]
    aws_s3_bucket.logs will be destroyed because it left the configuration, and aws_s3_bucket.audit_logs will be created with the same bucket ("fixture-alb-access-logs-eu-west-2"). Terraform does not know they are the same object. The S3 bucket would be destroyed with it, losing every object and object version in the bucket.
    -> Add a moved block (from = aws_s3_bucket.logs, to = aws_s3_bucket.audit_logs) so Terraform changes the address in state instead. Applying as planned also tries to create a resource with the same bucket, which fails for globally named resources.

LOW (1)
  * aws_s3_bucket_versioning.logs will be destroyed [PLAN-DELETE-001]
    The S3 bucket versioning is destroyed because it is no longer in the configuration.
    -> Confirm nothing outside this configuration still depends on it.
